_comment: H5: the gateway profiles bin/e2e accepts (names as e2e/lib/profile.ts GATEWAY_PROFILES) and what each needs from the head it runs on. e2e/scripts/gateway-profile.mjs reads this file for bin/e2e. requires: each {file} must exist in the checkout and, with contains, hold that exact text (the gateway loads its file with KnownFields, so a yaml tag it lacks stops it at start). overlays are added to the compose command, services are started next to the stack's own. A profile with a requirement missing is refused before anything starts; unblockedBy names the head that has it.

mcp.unblockedBy: the MCP line (release-next/mcp-apps c584a4486a, gw/MCP-CRED-REVOKE-W4-1): the gateway connectors section, the mcp-mock overlay and bin/e2e build mcpmock; mock extensions from gw/E2E-WALK-MOCKS-1

mcp-signin.unblockedBy: the MCP line (gw/MCP-CRED-REVOKE-W4-1 and the G13b build): the gateway connectors section and MCP client sign-in, the mcp-mock overlay; mock /register and /revoke from gw/E2E-WALK-MOCKS-1

mcp-otel.unblockedBy: G16 spans (gw/G16-W5-SPANS-1 5431964337: tenant privacy.trace_content and MCP full-content capture) on the MCP line, plus the otlp-sink service from gw/E2E-WALK-MOCKS-1 in e2e/stack/docker-compose.walk-mocks.yml

pricefeed.unblockedBy: G8-A public price feed (gw/G8-PRICE-FEED-1 12d24e74da: agentcc-gateway/internal/config public_price_feed)

onekey-cat.unblockedBy: INT-4: gw/ONEKEY-CAT-2 1ca0af80f5 has no configuration key for the CAT-2 opt-in (catalog.Model.InclusiveEnabled is an in-process gate set only in tests, agentcc-gateway/internal/catalog/catalog.go); the profile file and its delta are written once INT-4 names the operator setting

cloud-mode.unblockedBy: Contract 713: main must announce acceptance with a head and job; E2E_CLOUD_MODE_OVERLAY is VM-only attach metadata, never a signing file.
